name: London Breakout (Tokyo last-hour range, 30m confirm)
author: je-suis-tm
indicators: threshold = high/low of last hour before London open (EST 02:00-03:00); open_minutes=30; risky_stop=0.01 (target/stop 50bp, 200bp max)
entry_long: price breaks above range high during first 30 min of London open
exit: target/stop 50 bps; flat at end of London session
implementation_notes: Time-zone/DST handling is manual in source (histdata is EST without DST). FX data not crypto; crypto analogue would use Asia/EU session. Needs minute data. Repo note: educational scripts (Yahoo/histdata), not production.
